item.title: Babble, 2025-08-04 09:53 – working with the Org-roam database
item.description:
In this babble I’m going to be looking at how to work with the Org-roam database, toward the goal of being able to produce something like Obsidian Dataview queries within my Org-roam files, when they’re published to emsenn.net.

In looking online, there’s folk who use org-roam-db-query to load up the database and search through it with Elisp. But this is wildly inefficient, when there’s a where argument that can be set to use the database’s search algorithms.

item.title: Thinking how to handle multiple cosmos in GnoponEmacs
item.description:
In my last babble, I posed the question to myself, how would I organize my files if they were themselves the “dimension” part of a MUD - that is, the library, in the classic engine/library split.

But the difference is that we might have data files that are Org-mode at their core, but tangle out Python and LISP…

…I’m actually being distracted by my family as I try and write this - which isn’t a complaint! But it’s making it hard to build the sequence of thoughts I’m trying to convey to myself.
